## Work
- Backend Developer Intern @ Aarogya Virohan (Apr 2026–Present): FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL. Patient registration, clinic management, posture diagnostics. JWT auth with clinic-isolation middleware, prescription PDF builder.
- Freelance Backend Developer (Aug 2026–Present): TypeScript + Fastify 5 backend for a tour & travel business. Fares, bookings, Razorpay payments, dispatch, catalog APIs. JWT auth, Zod validation, rate limiting. PostgreSQL (Supabase) + MongoDB, Dockerized on Render.

## Projects
- ArenaAI: production travel platform (React, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Razorpay, Cloudflare). Live: [agraskbagheltourandtravels.com](https://agraskbagheltourandtravels.com) — Repo: [github.com/tarun1sisodia/ArenaAI](https://github.com/tarun1sisodia/ArenaAI)
- FreeTune: scalable music-streaming backend (Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Redis, Cloudflare R2). JWT auth, Redis caching + rate limiting, MongoDB analytics pipelines.
- CineMatch: full-stack movie recommendation platform (React, FastAPI, scikit-learn, SQLite). Content-based filtering with TF-IDF + cosine similarity.
- SmartCampus: cross-platform attendance app (Flutter, Node.js, MySQL). Recording, teacher workflows, analytics dashboards.
